description: Figure 7 displays the accuracy of the Llama3.3 model on the PopQA dataset as a function of entity popularity. The x-axis, labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)", represents the subject entity popularity, with values ranging from 1 to 19, corresponding to the frequency of the subject entity in the training data. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", measures the model's performance, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot features two data series: a blue line with circular markers representing the accuracy for subject entities (s_prop), and a green line with square markers representing the accuracy for object entities (o_prop). The blue line shows a general upward trend, starting at an accuracy of approximately 0.7 and increasing to about 1.0. The green line shows a more fluctuating pattern, starting at an accuracy of approximately 0.4, rising to a peak of about 0.7, and then fluctuating around 0.6. The error bars on the data points indicate the variability in the measurements.
